I would argue the structural collapse is closer to Severity 4 because the primary interface mechanism (the wheel) is completely missing/hallucinated into the cube.

I agree with the Router's findings but elevate the impact of the 'Structural Collapse' because it removes the defining feature of the class (the ignition mechanism).
